description: Angular component for the home page of the recipe application, managing search, recipe list display, and modal for recipe details.

classes.name: HomeComponent
classes.description: Angular component that manages the homepage, incorporating search, recipe listing, and modal detail view functionalities.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Updates the search term and reloads the recipe list based on the new query.

methods.name: onFavChange
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling changes to favorite status of recipes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches recipes from the RecipeService based on the current search term.

methods.name: openModal
methods.description: Opens the modal with the selected recipe's details.
